tagline: CTO of a Series B tech company scaling engineering operations
description: Marcus is focused on maintaining development velocity while ensuring security doesn't become a bottleneck for his engineers.
rationale: Marcus represents the 'Growth Persona'—a high-LTV segment that values API-first architecture and developer experience.

Investing in Marcus allows the company to move 'up-market' by proving the tool can handle complex, high-velocity environments.
